find.match_belief: I’ve always had a big passion for arts and crafts growing up and then it transitioned into photography. I loved the idea that every photograph had a different interpretation based on the person viewing it. I picked up film photography in college and i love that film can make any ordinary or dull moment look and feel so nostalgic and beautiful. The entertainment industry as a whole has a way of uniting people that might even have different day to day interests. My favorite icebreaker is “what show are you watching right now?” it’s so fun to discuss easter eggs in cinema as well.

profile.belief: I want to champion diverse voices and stories on screen.
profile.working_on: Being Film Producer and creating more Asian representation.
